title: Join a room's call, choose devices, talk and leave, while the call survives reading

tasks.title: The call state machine and its transition table
The media seam, the LiveKit engine loaded on demand, and the call controller
Join call, the pre-join step, tiles and controls in the persistent mount

acs.text: WHEN the call state machine (`features/av/machine.ts`, states off, prejoin, connecting, in-call, reconnecting, ended) is given any event THE SYSTEM SHALL follow its transition table, and a test SHALL cover every allowed and every forbidden transition
scenarios: AC-001 the call state machine follows its table

acs.text: WHEN a viewer is in a room (its lobby, or the reader with `ctx=social.room.<id>`) and the room says calls are available THE SYSTEM SHALL show a "Join call" button in the lobby and in the follow bar; WHEN calls are not available it SHALL show none
scenarios: AC-002 the Join call button appears only when calls are available

acs.text: WHEN a page loads and the viewer has not clicked "Join call" THE SYSTEM SHALL not load the LiveKit client code, connect to LiveKit, or ask for camera or microphone access
scenarios: AC-003 nothing of the call loads before Join call

acs.text: WHEN the viewer clicks "Join call" THE SYSTEM SHALL show a pre-join step with microphone and camera both off, device choosers, and a camera preview once the viewer turns the camera on; "Join" connects with exactly the choices made there
scenarios: AC-004 the pre-join step starts with everything off

acs.text: WHEN the browser denies camera or microphone access THE SYSTEM SHALL say how to allow it, still let the viewer join to listen, and leave the room session as it was

WHILE in a call THE SYSTEM SHALL play every other participant's audio, show their video, and let the viewer turn their microphone and camera on and off and share their screen where the browser supports it

WHEN the viewer clicks "Leave call" THE SYSTEM SHALL disconnect from LiveKit, stop every local track (camera light off) and keep the viewer in the room; WHEN the viewer leaves the room THE SYSTEM SHALL leave its call first
scenarios: AC-007 leaving the call keeps the room, leaving the room ends the call

acs.text: WHEN the viewer joins a call in a second room while in a call THE SYSTEM SHALL ask first, and on confirmation leave the first call before joining
scenarios: AC-008 one call at a time

acs.text: WHILE in a call, WHEN the viewer navigates inside the reader (another ref, enlarge, minimise, any `/social` page) THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the call connected without a new join
WHEN the page is loaded cold with `ctx=social.room.<id>` THE SYSTEM SHALL reconnect the room (R11) and offer "Join call", and SHALL NOT join the call or ask for devices by itself
scenarios: AC-010 a reload never rejoins by itself

acs.text: WHEN the connection to LiveKit drops THE SYSTEM SHALL show that it is reconnecting, reconnect with a fresh token, and after 30 seconds without success end the call with a "Rejoin" button

WHEN the viewer joins, leaves, reconnects or hits an error THE SYSTEM SHALL report `av.join`, `av.leave` (`durationS`, `peakParticipants`), `av.reconnect` or `av.error` (`kind`) through `host.report`, with no names, identities or device labels
scenarios: AC-012 reports carry no personal data
